name: jack burpee
description: A burpee with a jumping jack at the end. It raises your heart rate and trains the whole body.
instructions: Start standing with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place both hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a high plank and perform a push-up.
Jump your feet forward into a squat.
Jump up into a jumping jack, spreading your feet apart as your arms reach overhead.
Land softly, bring your feet back together, and begin the next repetition.
